{{Quote| We worked closely together on the Ossus Project. I admired Kol&hellip;the eyes of Yun-Ne'Shel shone brightly upon him.|Nei Rin to [[Cade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Legacy 12" />}}
The '''Funeral of Kol Skywalker''' took place after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] died during the [[Massacre at Ossus]], while buying time for his former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Wolf Sazen]] to escape with his son [[Cade Skywalker|Cade]], [[Shado Vao]] and a number of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi younglings]]. Skywalker was killed by [[Darth Nihl]], [[Fist]] of the [[One Sith]], who left the body of the fallen Jedi Master exposed.<ref name="Legacy 1" />

Upon returning from a mission into the [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] wilderness to find samples, [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Master Shaper]] [[Nei Rin]] found Skywalker's body lying at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]] and gave it a proper funeral. During the cremation, Skywalker's body disincorporated, becoming one with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. To honor Skywalker and the Jedi legacy, Rin, alongside [[Liaan Lah]] and [[Choka Skell]] gathered all the Jedi artifacts they could find and kept them safe in the underlevels of the Academy.<ref name="Legacy 12" />
